unit.why: A one-sentence report, heard from the Rav, of the Besht's habitual conduct: no money stayed with him overnight, and on returning from a journey he paid his debts and gave the rest to charity that day. It describes a trait, with no single narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Short trait report. It probably attaches thematically to the surrounding Shivhei-Habesht material on the Besht's charity, but no neighbouring text was supplied.
